First release: Stellarium as a modern Selkies (WebRTC) web desktop for Unraid.

## Highlights
- **Stellarium in your browser** — the full desktop planetarium streamed over Selkies (WebRTC), so panning the sky, zooming into a nebula and scrubbing time stay smooth. No VNC client, no local install.
- **Fills the gap** — there is no maintained browser-desktop build of the actual Stellarium application ("Stellarium Web" is a separate, lighter web reimplementation). A real-time OpenGL sky is exactly the workload the old noVNC stack stutters on and WebRTC keeps fluid.
- **amd64 and arm64**, installed from Debian trixie's `stellarium` package, so it tracks Debian security updates.

## Details
- Built on `ghcr.io/linuxserver/baseimage-selkies:debiantrixie`.
- Software-GL (Mesa llvmpipe) render path so the sky draws even without a GPU; the base wires a real GPU through when one is passed to the container.
- No WebUI login by default for trusted-LAN use; set `CUSTOM_USER` + `PASSWORD` to enable HTTP basic auth.
- Config, location, downloaded star catalogues, landscapes and screenshots persist under `/config` (`/config/.stellarium`).
- Native per-architecture build with a boot-smoke gate (the `stellarium` binary is present and the WebUI serves) before publishing, plus a Trivy CVE scan.
